column3: Direct parallel: no protectors can help them apart from Allah.

Worship besides Allah leaves wrongdoers with no helper.

Harm occurring only by Allah's permission is too remote from the focus.

Past people with greater wealth and children perish, closely warning against the owner's boast.

Rules of household access are unrelated.

Makes divine help decisive: if Allah forsakes people, no one can help them afterward.
Explicitly names Allah as sufficient protector and sufficient helper.
Rejects worshiping beings besides Allah that possess neither harm nor benefit.
Warns that, apart from Allah, people will have neither protector nor intercessor.
Questions invoking besides Allah what can neither benefit nor harm.

Forbids following protectors apart from Allah.
Those invoked besides Allah cannot help their worshipers or themselves.
Challenges alleged intercessors besides Allah who have no power of harm or benefit.
Forbids calling on beings besides Allah that can neither benefit nor harm.
No one can remove harm from Allah except Him.
The destroyed peoples' gods besides Allah did not avail them when their Lord's command came.
Invocations besides Allah receive no answer and leave their callers empty-handed.
Satan disowns any power to compel or rescue those who followed him.
Those invoked besides Allah are created and cannot create.
False objects of worship possess no provision or power.
Those invoked besides Allah cannot remove or transfer affliction.
In sea distress, all beings invoked besides Allah vanish from thought.
Those invoked besides Allah themselves seek nearness, mercy, and fear their Lord.

People take gods besides Allah seeking might, directly challenging reliance on a supporting power.
The alleged gods will deny their worship and become adversaries to their devotees.
The calf could neither answer nor control harm or benefit.
Allah alone is God; His knowledge encompasses all things, excluding rival divine support.
Challenges taking gods apart from Allah without proof.
Calling on another besides Allah brings neither benefit nor protection and is manifest loss.
The false invoked patron is described as an evil protector and companion.
Those invoked besides Allah cannot create even a fly and cannot recover what it takes.
Calling another god alongside Allah has no proof and leads to final accountability.
False gods besides Allah create nothing and control neither harm, benefit, death, life, nor resurrection.
People worship besides Allah what neither benefits nor harms them.
In the Fire, followers acknowledge that their gods and leaders led them astray.
The condemned acknowledge that they have no devoted friend or intercessor.
The recurring question, 'Is there a god with Allah?', rejects rival divine agency.
Those who associated partners are summoned to call them, but receive no response.
Those worshiped besides Allah cannot provide for worshipers; provision must be sought from Allah.
Reliance on protectors besides Allah is likened to the frailest of homes.
The idolaters will have no intercessors among their alleged partners.
No alleged partner shares Allah's creating, providing, causing death, or giving life.
Allah is the Truth, while what is invoked besides Him is false.
Those invoked besides Allah possess nothing in heaven or earth and give Him no support.
Those called besides Allah possess no share even of a date stone.
Those called besides Allah cannot hear, answer, or acknowledge their devotees' association.
Gods besides Allah cannot make intercession avail or save anyone from harm.
The gods taken for support are unable to help their worshipers.
The alleged gods besides Allah cannot remove harm or withhold mercy decreed by Him.
Challenges taking intercessors besides Allah even when they possess nothing and understand nothing.
Those invoked besides Allah judge nothing, while Allah alone judges in truth.
Forbids worshiping those called upon besides Allah.
The former objects of worship vanish when their followers are called to account.
Those invoked besides Allah have no power of intercession.
What people earned and took in mockery will not avail them before punishment.
Challenges alleged partners besides Allah to show what they created or share in creation.
No one is more astray than one who calls besides Allah upon beings that cannot answer.
The invoked beings will become enemies of their worshipers and deny their worship.
The rhetorical question rejects any god for them besides Allah.
The named goddesses exemplify the powerless objects of association rejected by the surrounding passage.
Challenges the disbelievers to name an army that could help them apart from the Most Merciful.
Asks who could protect disbelievers from a painful punishment.
The Prophet declares no independent power to cause harm or guide.
Declares that none can protect from Allah and no refuge exists apart from Him.

Names Allah as the believers' protector and the best of helpers.
Rejects seeking strength and honor through disbelieving allies rather than Allah.
Names Allah, His Messenger, and the believers as the proper protecting allegiance.
Allah is the believers' protector because of their deeds.

The mutual protecting allegiance of believers gives the positive counterpart to failed worldly support.
Forbids setting another god beside Allah lest one become blameworthy and forsaken.
Allah shares His judgment with no one, directly excluding independent authority or support.
The impossibility of multiple gods safeguards the focus's exclusive divine authority.
Allah alone is the Truth, while whatever is invoked besides Him is false.
Allah answers the distressed, removes harm, and has no god alongside Him.
On the Day of Judgment, alleged partners are summoned but cannot answer their worshipers.
Alleged partners are summoned and cannot provide any proof or aid.
Intercession has no effect except by Allah's permission.
Taking protectors besides Allah is rejected even when framed as seeking nearness to Him.
Allah watches over those who take protectors apart from Him.
Allah is the true protector; He gives life to the dead and has power over all things.
Even idolaters acknowledge Allah as Creator, exposing the inconsistency of rival reliance.
No angelic intercession avails except after Allah permits it.
Places worship exclusively in Allah's mosques and forbids calling anyone alongside Him.
